controls: Plan 4 Task 4: is Lull's claim-level frame verification more than decoration?
preregistered: Committed with the harness and tagged before any control or ablation run: first as `controls-prereg`, then, after a review and before any run, as `controls-prereg-2` (the pin the harnesses check; see changes_since_first_pin). prereg.sha256 holds this file's sha256. Both harnesses refuse to run unless the tag is an ancestor of HEAD, its prereg.sha256 matches this file, and prereg.json, prereg.sha256, negative.py and ablation.py are unchanged since the tag. controls/verify_adapter.py (the only code that calls the engine's verifier) is deliberately not pinned, so a change of the engine's signature after the merge is a one-place edit there.
when: On the merged engine, after the Suite A scored run (results/suite_a.json) exists; the negative control also needs the showcase runs.

negative_control.question: How often does the verifier accept a correct-looking description against footage that does not show it?
negative_control.inputs: The published cues of the Suite A counting run (the runs listed in results/suite_a.json) and of the showcase runs passed in (LABEL=RUN_DIR::VIDEO).
negative_control.selection: Every published verified cue: standard cues with status 'verified' (a gap id), extended cues with status 'extended' (no gap id). Ordered by (video label, start, cue id). If there are more than max_cues, max_cues of them drawn with random.Random(seed).sample over that order, kept in that order. Cues without watch events are skipped and listed.
negative_control.true_clip: The engine's own verification window for the cue: clip_window(the cue's watch events, video duration) with the pipeline's padding, cap and minimum, cut at the pipeline's clip height.

mismatch.suite_a: The centre of another slide of the same lecture: among the slides the true window does not touch, that last at least as long as it and whose title is not the title of a slide it touches, the one whose start is nearest the true window's start (ties: the earlier); a window of the true window's length.
mismatch.showcase: A window of the true window's length, inside the video, at least away_s seconds from the true window, sharing at least min_event_overlap_s with one watch event and no time at all with any of the cue's events: the nearest such start on a grid_s grid (ties: the later).
mismatch.fallback: When the same video has no such window: the next video in label order (cyclic) that has room (Suite A: a slide at least as long whose title is not the title of a slide the true window touches, nearest the same start; showcase: a window sharing at least min_event_overlap_s with a watch event, nearest the same start). Rule 'other video'.
mismatch.recorded: Every row records its rule, the mismatched video, window and slide, the watch events the mismatched window overlaps with the seconds shared, and the cue's events among them (none for the same video, by the rule).

negative_control.verifier: The engine's verification function (lull.stages.verify.verify, through controls/verify_adapter.py) with the pipeline's model and settings (Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, its prompt, temperature and token limit), on (the cue's final text, the clip, the clip's start as offset), with no names. Answers cached by (text, clip sha256, offset, settings).

metrics.false_accept: Share of cues whose mismatched clip supports every claim (at least one claim).
metrics.false_accept_claims: Supported claims / claims on the mismatched clips.
metrics.true_accept: Share of cues whose true clip supports every claim.
metrics.by_rule: Each metric and the number of rows, separately for every mismatch rule ('another slide', 'other events, 30 s away', 'other video').
metrics.interval: 95% percentile bootstrap over cues, 10 000 resamples, seed 20261028 (Suite A's bootstrap_ratio).

negative_control.report: results/controls_negative.json and results/CONTROLS.md (only with the Suite A runs and at least one showcase run, from a clean tree; else controls/out/partial/): the metrics, and every false accept with its text, its true clip times and the mismatched video and clip times and rule; every true clip not fully supported.
negative_control.budget: About 80 verifier calls (2 per cue); cap $0.50 per invocation.
negative_control.headline: The raw false accept (per cue, and per claim) over the same-video rules only ('another slide', 'other events, 30 s away'); 'other video' fallback rows are reported separately and never pooled into it. It is an UPPER BOUND on verifier failure: it also counts claims that are genuinely true of the other footage (a generic layout, a recurring setting).
negative_control.discriminative: Suite A only (same-video rows): a false accept is discriminative when the cue conveys at least one key visual fact of a TRUE slide (a slide the true window touches) that the mismatched slide does not show. Conveyed: the Suite A primary judge's coverage verdict for that cue in the scored run (results/suite_a.json, videos[].detail.facts[].cue_ids); when the run kept no per-fact verdicts, an exact match instead: the slide title as a phrase (title_match) or a chart value with its category (value_match). Not shown by the mismatched slide: a chart value when its chart has no point with that category and value; a trend when it has no line chart; any other fact when its anchor text is no item of the slide (title, bullet, chart title, axis or point label) as a phrase. Rate: discriminative false accepts / Suite A same-video rows, with the same bootstrap. The showcase videos have no key: raw false accept only.
negative_control.true_accept_bias: True accept is an optimistic upper bound on the verifier's consistency: every selected cue already passed verification (selection on the outcome), and 'edited' cues, whose text a person changed after verification, are excluded.

ablation.question: How much does hallucination rise when the verifier is switched off?
ablation.added_after: Added after the pre-registration of Suite A (tag suite-a-prereg); Suite A's own pin applies unchanged.
ablation.runs: Suite A's 12 lectures run again by Suite A's run function and options (mode standard, profile education, voice Sofia, research off, no source URL) into controls/out/ablation/runs/ with run ids ablation-<id>-<stamp>, in a process started with LULL_NO_VERIFY=1; every run's manifest must record verification 'disabled' (else the harness stops). Cues the engine voiced unverified (status 'unverified') count as published.
ablation.with_arm: The Suite A counting run (results/suite_a.json: complete, on the same engine fingerprint as the ablation process; else the harness refuses).
ablation.judging: Suite A's primary judge (Nemotron 3 Ultra, temperature 0, reasoning on) with Suite A's coverage, claims and voiced-text requests, answers cached in controls/out/ablation/judge/; Suite A's video_metrics.
ablation.headline: hallucination_voiced_text: the judge splits both arms' voiced text the same way. The claims metric depends on the verifier's claim split, which the ablation switches off (without it Suite A judges each cue's whole text as one claim), so it is reported with the share of cues that carry a claim split in each arm.
ablation.difference: Per metric: pooled rate of each arm over the same videos, the difference (without - with) and its 95% percentile bootstrap over videos (the same resampled videos in both arms; 10 000 resamples, seed 20261028). The comparison refuses unless every requested video is paired in both arms; results/ (the headline) needs all 12.
ablation.report: results/ablation.json and results/ABLATION.md, never results/suite_a.json; only for all 12 videos from a clean tree, else controls/out/partial/.
ablation.budget: The Suite A pipeline cost without the verifier's calls plus Suite A judging: about $0.7-0.8 for 12 videos; cap $2.00 per invocation.

changes_since_first_pin: negative control: metrics and row counts per mismatch rule; the headline uses the same-video rules only and is called an upper bound on verifier failure
negative control: the discriminative false accept for Suite A (judge coverage verdicts of the scored run, exact-match fallback)
negative control: true accept disclosed as an optimistic upper bound (pass-selected cues, edited cues excluded)
negative control: an event match needs at least 0.5 s of overlap; rows record their event overlap; a fallback (and same-video) slide never carries the title of a slide the true window touches
ablation: the comparison refuses unless every requested video is paired (12 for results/)
no control or ablation had been run under the first pin
